rationale: 4-point Volt-VAR curve with max injection (0.8) at low voltage (0.94 pu) to mitigate sag, and max absorption (-0.8) at high voltage (1.06 pu) to mitigate swell. Curve is strictly increasing in voltage_pu and monotonic non-increasing in q_fraction. All corrected voltages stay within 0.95-1.05 pu limits and reactive power commands stay within inverter capability.
